Aconitum Napellus.safety_note: Aconitine is a potent neurotoxin and cardiotoxin; ingestion of the plant can cause fatal arrhythmias and respiratory paralysis within hours, and skin contact can be harmful. Conium.evidence_note: Systematic reviews (e.g., Australia's NHMRC 2015, Cochrane) find no reliable evidence that homeopathy works beyond placebo for any condition; no remedy-specific trial evidence was located to change this.
